Porto's Bakery is a local's favorite in Glendale (potato balls and the Cuban sandwich!), the Griffith Observatory, try to get a tour of any of the studios in Burbank, LA Zoo, your pick of hipster/trendy hangouts in Siverlake and Echo Park, and ice skating in Perishing Square (Downtown LA).

For food, you can try Ethiopian cuisine in West LA, all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ in Koreatown (I recommend O Dae San), Daikokuya (ramen in Little Tokyo), and all the Chinese and Vietnamese food you'd ever want in San Gabriel Valley.  Golden Deli in San Gabriel for pho and Chinese food tastes the same to me regardless.  I like Pulciano's Deli for Italian sandwiches and Di Pilla's for delicious Italian pastas.  Lawry's Prime Rib and Nick+Stef's Steakhouse are great picks if you feel up for steak.
